paragraphs: R' Yishmael bar Katriel: see the entry R' Yishmael ben Katriel.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The second spelling ישמעל omits the alef of ישמעאל; the English name remains Yishmael.

Both personal titles are abbreviated and retained as R'. The first ישמעאל and second ישמעל differ by an omitted alef, though both retain the inherited English Yishmael rendering. Bar in the first occurrence and ben in the target remain. The cross-reference does not independently establish that the names are one authority.
